extends Node2D
## A fixture, not the game: Effect A over Level 1 at in-game camera scale, for
## the frame strip (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, section 6). Every capture of it is a
## fixture capture.
## The real level is the background, with its gameplay objects frozen; a
## frozen sprite of Rudy in CHAR-SWORD-SLASH, drawn as rudy.tscn draws him,
## stands at x = 2200 facing right, so his hitbox is at (2250, 764), where both
## bursts sit. Burst1 fires on frame 10; with `retrigger` on, Burst2 fires on
## frame 20, 0.333 s later at 30 fps, and Burst1 runs on. The two bursts are
## separate instances, as the overlap rule asks (A3), each with its own fixed
## seed, set in the scene. Frames are counted from 0, one per _process(), which
## is one Movie Maker frame. Capture at 30 fps with --quit-after 60.

const FIRST_FRAME := 10
const SECOND_FRAME := 20
## Level 1's gameplay objects, held still so the background does not change.
const FROZEN: Array[NodePath] = [^"Level1/Enemies", ^"Level1/Hazards", ^"Level1/SwordPickup",
	^"Level1/Waystone", ^"Level1/Portal"]

@export var retrigger := true

var _frame := 0


func _ready() -> void:
	for path in FROZEN:
		get_node(path).process_mode = Node.PROCESS_MODE_DISABLED


func _process(_delta: float) -> void:
	if _frame == FIRST_FRAME:
		_fire($Burst1)
	elif _frame == SECOND_FRAME and retrigger:
		_fire($Burst2)
	_frame += 1


func _fire(burst: Node2D) -> void:
	for emitter: GPUParticles2D in burst.get_children():
		emitter.emitting = true
	print("PREVIEW frame %d: %s fired at %s" % [_frame, burst.name, burst.global_position])

extends SceneTree
## Configuration checks for Effect A, the sword-swing sparks (CHANGE-BRIEF.md,
## section 2, "The settings"). Run from the assignment folder:
##   scripts/run-test.sh test_slash_sparks_config.gd 60
## Prints one line per check and exits with code 1 if any check fails.
##
## It loads game/effects/slash_sparks.tscn and reads every setting the brief's
## table names back from the loaded nodes and resources, with the brief's
## values as the expected values. It reads the Godot 4 _min/_max values, never
## whether a name exists: a Godot 3 line such as `initial_velocity = 260.0`
## loads without a message and leaves initial_velocity_min at 0, which fails
## here (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Revision 2). Godot 4.7.2 maps the Godot 3 class names
## and flag_disable_z silently, so no loaded value can show them; the scene's
## text is scanned for them instead.
## Headless, nothing is drawn: these are the settings, not the look.

const SCENE_PATH := "res://effects/slash_sparks.tscn"
const EPS := 1e-4
const COLOR_EPS := 1e-3
const VISIBILITY := Rect2(-50, -100, 270, 230)
const TEXTURE_OFFSETS := [0.0, 0.55, 0.70, 0.85]
const TEXTURE_COLORS := [Color("#FFFFF0", 1.0), Color("#FFE58A", 1.0), Color("#290F0D", 1.0), Color("#290F0D", 0.0)]

## Each emitter's expected settings, from the brief's table.
const EXPECTED := {
	"Flash": {
		"amount": 1, "one_shot": true, "explosiveness": 1.0, "lifetime": 0.12,
		"texture_size": Vector2i(64, 64),
		"emission_shape": ParticleProcessMaterial.EMISSION_SHAPE_POINT,
		"direction": Vector3(1, 0, 0), "spread": 0.0,
		"initial_velocity": [0.0, 0.0], "gravity": Vector3(0, 0, 0), "damping": [0.0, 0.0],
		"align_y": false, "lifetime_randomness": 0.0, "scale": [0.9, 1.1],
		"scale_curve": [Vector2(0, 1.0), Vector2(1, 1.3)],
		"ramp_offsets": [0.0, 1.0], "ramp_colors": [Color(1, 1, 1, 1), Color(1, 1, 1, 0)],
		"hue_variation": [0.0, 0.0],
	},
	"Sparks": {
		"amount": 28, "one_shot": true, "explosiveness": 1.0, "lifetime": 0.45,
		"texture_size": Vector2i(12, 40),
		"emission_shape": ParticleProcessMaterial.EMISSION_SHAPE_POINT,
		"direction": Vector3(0.944, -0.330, 0), "spread": 30.0,
		"initial_velocity": [260.0, 420.0], "gravity": Vector3(0, 700, 0), "damping": [0.0, 0.0],
		"align_y": true, "lifetime_randomness": 0.4, "scale": [0.7, 1.1],
		"scale_curve": [Vector2(0, 1.0), Vector2(1, 0.3)],
		"ramp_offsets": [0.0, 0.25, 0.7, 1.0],
		"ramp_colors": [Color(1, 1, 1, 1), Color(1, 0.9, 0.45, 1), Color(1, 0.55, 0.2, 1), Color(0.9, 0.35, 0.15, 0)],
		"hue_variation": [-0.03, 0.03],
	},
}

var _failures := 0


func _initialize() -> void:
	var scene := load(SCENE_PATH) as PackedScene
	_check("the scene loads as a PackedScene", scene != null, SCENE_PATH)
	if scene == null:
		_finish()
		return
	_check_source_names()
	var root := scene.instantiate()
	_check_root(root)
	for emitter_name: String in EXPECTED:
		var emitter := root.get_node_or_null(emitter_name) as GPUParticles2D
		_check("%s is a GPUParticles2D child of the root" % emitter_name, emitter != null,
			"" if emitter else "found %s" % root.get_node_or_null(emitter_name))
		if emitter:
			_check_emitter(emitter, EXPECTED[emitter_name])
	root.free()
	_finish()


func _finish() -> void:
	print("%s  test_slash_sparks_config: %d failure(s)" % ["PASS" if _failures == 0 else "FAIL", _failures])
	quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)


## Godot 3 names the engine maps or drops without a message (CLAUDE.md,
## "Godot 4 names"): no loaded value can show them, so the file is read.
func _check_source_names() -> void:
	var text := FileAccess.get_file_as_string(SCENE_PATH)
	var g3_class := RegEx.create_from_string("type=\"(Particles2D|ParticlesMaterial)\"")
	var found := g3_class.search_all(text).map(func(m: RegExMatch) -> String: return m.get_string(1))
	_check("the scene file names no Godot 3 class", found.is_empty(), "found %s" % [found] if found else "")
	var g3_prop := RegEx.create_from_string("^(flag_disable_z|flag_align_y|flag_rotate_y|initial_velocity|scale|damping|hue_variation|angular_velocity|linear_accel|radial_accel|tangential_accel|angle) =")
	var in_material := false
	var bad: Array[String] = []
	for line in text.split("\n"):
		if line.begins_with("["):
			in_material = line.contains("type=\"ParticleProcessMaterial\"") or line.contains("type=\"ParticlesMaterial\"")
		elif in_material and g3_prop.search(line):
			bad.append(line.strip_edges())
	_check("no process material in the file has a Godot 3 property line", bad.is_empty(), "found %s" % [bad] if bad else "")

# scripts/run-test.sh <test-file> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]
#
# The course's Assignment 6 wrapper, changed in four places for this folder:
#   - The project is game/ (the 2D game, from Assignment 2), so it runs
#     --path game; the course's version runs --path godot. Assignment 6 builds
#     in the 2D game only, so this folder holds no other project.
#   - A .tscn test runs as the scene, as the game's checks.tscn always has (its
#     script extends Node, so --script cannot run it); a .gd test still runs
#     with --script. The log is named after the file without its extension.
#   - Godot is $GODOT if set, else godot on PATH, else the macOS app's binary.
#   - It runs from this folder wherever it is called from, so the project path
#     resolves and the logs land in its logs/.
# Unchanged from the course: the realtime mode (no --fixed-fps, for tests that
# wait on audio), the optional timeout (120 s by default; status 124 means the
# test hung), the log name logs/<test>_<fps>fps.log or logs/<test>_realtime.log,
# and failing on any SHADER ERROR or SCRIPT ERROR line, because exit code 0
# does not mean no errors.
set -o pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
if [ $# -lt 2 ] || [ $# -gt 3 ] || [ ! -f "game/tests/$1" ]; then
	echo "usage: scripts/run-test.sh <test-file in game/tests/> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]" >&2
	exit 2
fi
godot=${GODOT:-$(command -v godot || echo /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot)}
if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
	fps_args=(); tag="realtime"
else
	fps_args=(--fixed-fps "$2"); tag="${2}fps"
fi
if [[ $1 == *.tscn ]]; then
	run_args=("res://tests/$1")
else
	run_args=(--script "res://tests/$1")
fi
mkdir -p logs
log="logs/$(basename "${1%.*}")_${tag}.log"
timeout "${3:-120}" "$godot" --headless "${fps_args[@]}" --path game "${run_args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
status=$?
if grep -qE "SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR" "$log"; then status=1; fi
exit $status

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# scripts/run-test.sh <test-file> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]
#
# The course's Assignment 6 wrapper, changed in four places for this folder:
#   - The project is game/ (the 2D game, from Assignment 2), so it runs
#     --path game; the course's version runs --path godot. Assignment 6 builds
#     in the 2D game only, so this folder holds no other project.
#   - A .tscn test runs as the scene, as the game's checks.tscn always has (its
#     script extends Node, so --script cannot run it); a .gd test still runs
#     with --script. The log is named after the file without its extension.
#   - Godot is $GODOT if set, else godot on PATH, else the macOS app's binary.
#   - It runs from this folder wherever it is called from, so the project path
#     resolves and the logs land in its logs/.
# Unchanged from the course: the realtime mode (no --fixed-fps, for tests that
# wait on audio), the optional timeout (120 s by default; status 124 means the
# test hung), the log name logs/<test>_<fps>fps.log or logs/<test>_realtime.log,
# and failing on any SHADER ERROR or SCRIPT ERROR line, because exit code 0
# does not mean no errors.
set -o pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." || exit 2
if [ $# -lt 2 ] || [ $# -gt 3 ] || [ ! -f "game/tests/$1" ]; then
	echo "usage: scripts/run-test.sh <test-file in game/tests/> <fps|realtime> [timeout-seconds]" >&2
	exit 2
fi
godot=${GODOT:-$(command -v godot || echo /Applications/Godot.app/Contents/MacOS/Godot)}
if [ "$2" = "realtime" ]; then
	fps_args=(); tag="realtime"
else
	fps_args=(--fixed-fps "$2"); tag="${2}fps"
fi
if [[ $1 == *.tscn ]]; then
	run_args=("res://tests/$1")
else
	run_args=(--script "res://tests/$1")
fi
mkdir -p logs
log="logs/$(basename "${1%.*}")_${tag}.log"
timeout "${3:-120}" "$godot" --headless "${fps_args[@]}" --path game "${run_args[@]}" 2>&1 | tee "$log"
status=$?
if grep -qE "SHADER ERROR|SCRIPT ERROR" "$log"; then status=1; fi
exit $status

## Starts the presentation effects from the game's state (CHANGE-BRIEF.md).
## It only reads game state, and it only places, mirrors, starts and frees the
## effects: their settings live in their scene files.
##
## Effect A, the sword-swing sparks: each tick that Rudy's sword hitbox goes
## from disabled to live, a new SlashSparks burst starts at the hitbox, facing
## his way. Every cut gets its own burst, so a fast second cut leaves the first
## one running (rule A3), and each burst frees itself once its sparks finish.
## It sits after Rudy in Main, so it sees the edge on the tick _swing() makes it.

const SLASH_SPARKS := preload("res://effects/slash_sparks.tscn")

var _box_was_disabled: bool

@onready var _rudy: Rudy = get_node("../Rudy")
@onready var _sword_box: CollisionShape2D = _rudy.get_node("SwordHitbox/Shape")
@onready var _slash_bursts: Node2D = $SlashBursts


func _ready() -> void:
	_box_was_disabled = _sword_box.disabled # so a load never fires a burst


func _physics_process(_delta: float) -> void:
	var disabled := _sword_box.disabled
	if _box_was_disabled and not disabled:
		_fire_slash_sparks()
	_box_was_disabled = disabled


func _fire_slash_sparks() -> void:
	var burst: Node2D = SLASH_SPARKS.instantiate() # a new burst per cut: overlap (A3)
	_slash_bursts.add_child(burst)
	burst.global_position = _sword_box.global_position
	burst.scale.x = _rudy.facing
	(burst.get_node("Sparks") as GPUParticles2D).finished.connect(burst.queue_free)
	for emitter: GPUParticles2D in burst.get_children():
		emitter.emitting = true

##   scripts/run-test.sh test_run_dust_config.gd 60

## table names back from the loaded node and resources, with the brief's
## values as the expected values. The process feature Effect B adds over
## Effect A is damping (damping_min / damping_max, 120 / 180 px/s²), with a box
## emission shape where Effect A has a point; both are read here. It reads the
## Godot 4 _min/_max values, never whether a name exists: a Godot 3 line such
## as `damping = 120.0` loads without a message and leaves damping_min at 0,
## which fails here (CHANGE-BRIEF.md, Revision 2). Godot 4.7.2 maps the Godot 3
## class names and flag_disable_z silently, so no loaded value can show them;
## the scene's text is scanned for them instead.
## Headless, nothing is drawn: these are the settings, not the look.

const SCENE_PATH := "res://effects/run_dust.tscn"
const EPS := 1e-4
const COLOR_EPS := 1e-3
const VISIBILITY := Rect2(-320, -80, 640, 110)
const TEXTURE_SIZE := Vector2i(32, 32)
const TEXTURE_OFFSETS := [0.0, 0.6, 1.0]
const TEXTURE_COLORS := [Color(1, 1, 1, 1), Color(1, 1, 1, 0.6), Color(1, 1, 1, 0)]

const SCALE_POINTS := [Vector2(0, 0.5), Vector2(0.4, 1.0), Vector2(1, 1.15)]
const SCALE_MIDPOINTS := [Vector2(0.2, 0.75), Vector2(0.7, 1.075)]

func _initialize() -> void:
	var scene := load(SCENE_PATH) as PackedScene
	_check("the scene loads as a PackedScene", scene != null, SCENE_PATH)
	if scene == null:
		_finish()
		return
	_check_source_names()
	var root := scene.instantiate()
	var e := root as GPUParticles2D
	_check("root is a GPUParticles2D named RunDust", e != null and root.name == &"RunDust",
		"%s %s" % [root.get_class(), root.name])
	_check("root has no children: one emitter, no layers", root.get_child_count() == 0, "%d" % root.get_child_count())

	print("%s  test_run_dust_config: %d failure(s)" % ["PASS" if _failures == 0 else "FAIL", _failures])
	quit(1 if _failures > 0 else 0)

	_check_float("RunDust randomness", e.randomness, 0.2)
	_check_float("RunDust lifetime", e.lifetime, 0.5)
	_check("RunDust emitting is false as saved", e.emitting == false, "%s" % e.emitting)
	_check_float("RunDust preprocess", e.preprocess, 0.0)
	_check("RunDust fixed_fps is 30", e.fixed_fps == 30, "%d" % e.fixed_fps)

	_check("RunDust particle_flag_align_y is false", m.particle_flag_align_y == false, "%s" % m.particle_flag_align_y)

	_check_float("RunDust initial_velocity_min", m.initial_velocity_min, 40.0)
	_check_float("RunDust initial_velocity_max", m.initial_velocity_max, 90.0)
	_check("RunDust gravity is (0, 0, 0)", m.gravity.is_equal_approx(Vector3.ZERO), "%s" % m.gravity)
	# Damping: Effect B's process feature, which Effect A does not use.
	_check_float("RunDust damping_min", m.damping_min, 120.0)
	_check_float("RunDust damping_max", m.damping_max, 180.0)
	_check("RunDust damping has no curve, so it acts at full strength all life", m.damping_curve == null, "%s" % m.damping_curve)
	_check_float("RunDust lifetime_randomness", m.lifetime_randomness, 0.3)
	_check_float("RunDust scale_min", m.scale_min, 0.7)
	_check_float("RunDust scale_max", m.scale_max, 1.0)
	_check_float("RunDust hue_variation_min", m.hue_variation_min, -0.02)
	_check_float("RunDust hue_variation_max", m.hue_variation_max, 0.02)

	_check("RunDust color_ramp is a GradientTexture1D", ramp != null, "%s" % m.color_ramp)
	if ramp:
		_check_gradient("RunDust color_ramp", ramp.gradient, RAMP_OFFSETS, RAMP_COLORS)


func _check_texture(e: GPUParticles2D) -> void:
	var t := e.texture as GradientTexture2D
	_check("RunDust texture is a GradientTexture2D", t != null, "%s" % e.texture)
	if t == null:
		return
	var size := Vector2i(t.width, t.height)
	_check("RunDust texture is 32 x 32", size == TEXTURE_SIZE, "%s" % size)
	_check("RunDust texture fill is radial", t.fill == GradientTexture2D.FILL_RADIAL, "%d" % t.fill)
	_check("RunDust texture fill_from is (0.5, 0.5)", t.fill_from.is_equal_approx(Vector2(0.5, 0.5)), "%s" % t.fill_from)
	_check("RunDust texture fill_to is (1.0, 0.5)", t.fill_to.is_equal_approx(Vector2(1.0, 0.5)), "%s" % t.fill_to)

	if t == null or t.curve == null:
		_check("RunDust scale_curve has a curve", false)
		return

	_check("RunDust scale_curve has %d points" % SCALE_POINTS.size(), c.point_count == SCALE_POINTS.size(), "%d" % c.point_count)
	for p: Vector2 in SCALE_POINTS:
		var got := c.sample(p.x)
		_check("RunDust scale_curve is %.2f at %.1f" % [p.y, p.x], absf(got - p.y) < EPS, "%.4f" % got)
	# The brief gives only the points; between them it runs straight, not eased.
	for p: Vector2 in SCALE_MIDPOINTS:
		var got := c.sample(p.x)
		_check("RunDust scale_curve is linear (%.3f at %.1f)" % [p.y, p.x], absf(got - p.y) < 1e-3, "%.4f" % got)


func _check_gradient(what: String, g: Gradient, offsets: Array, colors: Array) -> void:
	_check("%s exists" % what, g != null)
	if g == null:
		return
	_check("%s has %d stops" % [what, offsets.size()], g.get_point_count() == offsets.size(), "%d" % g.get_point_count())
	if g.get_point_count() != offsets.size():
		return
	for i in offsets.size():
		var off := g.get_offset(i)
		var col := g.get_color(i)
		var want: Color = colors[i]
		var col_ok := absf(col.r - want.r) < COLOR_EPS and absf(col.g - want.g) < COLOR_EPS \

			absf(off - offsets[i]) < EPS and col_ok, "%s at %.4f" % [_rgba(col), off])


func _rgba(c: Color) -> String:
	return "(%.3f, %.3f, %.3f, %.2f)" % [c.r, c.g, c.b, c.a]


func _check_float(what: String, got: float, want: float) -> void:
	_check("%s is %s" % [what, want], absf(got - want) < EPS, "%s" % got)


func _check(what: String, ok: bool, detail: String = "") -> void:
	print("%s  %s%s" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what, "" if detail.is_empty() else "  (%s)" % detail])
	if not ok:
		_failures += 1
